en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a large Gothic brick cathedral dominating an open square. The façade has a central rose window, pointed arches, and three main doorways with ornate decoration. To the right rises a tall rectangular bell tower and additional church structures extending along the street. The scene is largely empty of people or vehicles, giving it an early-20th‑century feel. Printed text at the top right identifies the subject as the cathedral in Asti.
